metadata.case_name: KO FUNG v. PHYSICAL BEAUTY CENTRE (CENTRAL) LTD AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Burn injury to left face resulting in permanent scarring (left mid cheek rectangular patch)
source: she sustained burn injury to her left face.

Examination by Dr. Wong revealed rectangular erythematous area with blister on the left side of her face. Dr. Wong diagnosed the Plaintiff to have suffered from scald injury. After 8 sessions of treatment, the Plaintiff’s skin lesion was healed leaving a superfacial, pigmented scar.

Dr. King considered that she suffered from left mid cheek rectangular patch of permanent scarring due to burning injury. Dr. King took the view that her scar is permanent although further treatment may improve the appearance of the scar or improve the degree of scarring.
